title: Safe and Secure Innovation for Frontier Artificial Intelligence Models Act
last_action: Vetoed by the Governor; veto consideration expired November 30, 2024.
summary: Would have required developers of covered large AI models and certain compute providers to adopt safeguards and policies intended to prevent catastrophic harm and would have created a state frontier-model oversight body.
committee_dynamics: The bill passed both chambers but was vetoed; it remains important as the policy precursor to California SB 53.
verification_level: Official legislature record and veto message verified.
